28033.name: DeSoto County
a: Olive Branch Fire Department Ambulance Service

28039.name: George County
28039.via: Mississippi State Department of Health ambulance licence records plus county, city, provider and local news pages
28039.note: Acadian Ambulance Service has answered 911 ambulance calls in George County since October 6, 2026, replacing AmeriPro Health.

28045.name: Hancock County
28045.via: Mississippi State Department of Health ambulance licence records plus county, city, provider and local news pages
28045.note: Pafford EMS took over 911 ambulance service in Hancock County on May 24, 2024 and still serves it in 2025.

28047.name: Harrison County
28047.via: Mississippi State Department of Health ambulance licence records plus county, city, provider and local news pages
28047.note: Acadian Ambulance Service answers 911 ambulance calls in Harrison County outside Biloxi and Gulfport, including D'Iberville, Long Beach and Pass Christian (county contract since May 1, 2024; still operating in 2026). Pafford EMS answers 911 ambulance calls in the cities of Biloxi and Gulfport.

28049.name: Hinds County
a: Mobile Medic Ambulance Service – AMR- Central

28059.name: Jackson County
28059.via: Mississippi State Department of Health ambulance licence records plus county, city, provider and local news pages
28059.note: Acadian Ambulance Service is the Jackson County ambulance provider under a county contract (renewed by the Board of Supervisors in 2016; Acadian says it has served the county since 2000 and still does in 2026). The county ordinance names a single operations contractor for all emergency ambulance calls in the county.

28067.name: Jones County
28067.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. EMServ Ambulance Service answers 911 ambulance calls in Jones County: it transported patients from Powers, Moselle, Glade, Laurel and Ellisville in 2025-2026. A county or city page, contract or board record naming the 911 ambulance provider for Jones County, including Laurel, has not been found.

28071.name: Lafayette County
28071.via: Mississippi State Department of Health ambulance licence records plus county, city, provider and local news pages
28071.note: Baptist Ambulance (Baptist Memorial Hospital-North Mississippi, run with Priority Ambulance) holds the Lafayette County 911 ambulance priority under a county agreement and was still the ambulance at calls in Oxford and the county in 2026. CareMed EMS does private transports only.
a: Baptist Ambulance (Baptist Memorial Hospital-North Mississippi, operated with Priority Ambulance)

28075.name: Lauderdale County
28075.via: Mississippi State Department of Health ambulance licence records plus county, city, provider and local news pages
28075.note: Since September 18, 2026 Pafford EMS answers 911 ambulance calls inside the City of Meridian and Metro Ambulance Service answers them in the rest of Lauderdale County.

28085.name: Lincoln County
28085.via: Mississippi State Department of Health ambulance licence records plus county, city, provider and local news pages
28085.note: King's Daughters Medical Center Ambulance Service is the Lincoln County ambulance provider on the state list (revised September 2026). The hospital told the Board of Supervisors in February 2025 that its ambulance service ran 7,137 calls in 2024 with three ambulances working in the county, and it responded to a Highway 84 crash on August 4, 2026.
a: King's Daughters Medical Center Ambulance Service

28089.name: Madison County
28089.via: Mississippi State Department of Health ambulance licence records plus county, city, provider and local news pages
28089.note: Pafford EMS answers 911 ambulance calls in Madison County: the Board of Supervisors replaced AMR with Pafford as the county ambulance provider in May 2016, and Pafford transported patients from Madison (2024), Ridgeland (2024) and Gluckstadt (2026). The Madison and Ridgeland fire departments are licensed for non-transport care only.

28095.name: Monroe County
28095.via: Mississippi State Department of Health ambulance licence records plus county, city, provider and local news pages
28095.note: MedStat EMS is the Monroe County ambulance provider on the state list (revised September 2026). The Board of Supervisors approved an extension of its county ambulance contract on July 24, 2026 (the Monroe Journal of August 26, 2026 calls it countywide ambulance service through MedStat), and the Monroe Journal of October 14, 2026 says MedStat provides four ambulances to cover the county. Supervisors discussed times when there were not enough ambulances.

28107.name: Panola County
28107.via: Mississippi State Department of Health ambulance licence records plus county, city, provider and local news pages
28107.note: Lifeguard Ambulance Service is the Panola County ambulance provider on the state list (revised September 2026) under a county contract of about $55,000 a month for at least three ambulances (Panolian, January 2025). The Panolian of September 24, 2025 describes Lifeguard as the ambulance service in Panola County, and the county's current budget (Panolian, October 22, 2026) includes ambulance services.

28109.name: Pearl River County
28109.via: Mississippi State Department of Health ambulance licence records plus county, city, provider and local news pages
28109.note: AAA Ambulance Service holds the Pearl River County ambulance contract (county and the cities of Picayune and Poplarville); the Board of Supervisors accepted its monthly report in 2025 and Picayune extended its contract in April 2026.

28121.name: Rankin County
28121.via: Mississippi State Department of Health ambulance licence records plus county, city, provider and local news pages
28121.note: Pafford EMS answers 911 ambulance calls in Rankin County: it took the cities of Pearl and Brandon from AMR in 2015 and began an exclusive county contract in June 2016, and it was the ambulance at 2024-2026 calls in Pearl, Brandon, Flowood, Star, Reservoir and Puckett. No fire department in the county holds an ambulance transport licence.

28131.name: Stone County
28131.via: Mississippi State Department of Health ambulance licence records plus county, city, provider and local news pages
28131.note: Pafford EMS holds a three-year ground ambulance contract with Stone County, the City of Wiggins and Memorial Hospital at Stone County, in effect since November 4, 2024, and still served the county in 2025.

28149.name: Warren County
28149.via: Mississippi State Department of Health ambulance licence records plus county, city, provider and local news pages
28149.note: The Vicksburg Fire Department has run the Vicksburg Warren Ambulance Service since 1969 and is the Warren County ambulance provider on the state list (revised September 2026). It transported patients from a call in North Warren County on July 29, 2026, and the city signed a new hospital transport agreement for the service on August 25, 2026.

28151.name: Washington County
28151.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. Pafford EMS answers 911 ambulance calls in Washington County: it was the ambulance at a Greenville call in 2026, and its station list names Greenville, Leland and Hollandale. A county or city page, contract or board record naming the 911 ambulance provider for Washington County, including Greenville, has not been found.
